name: integer_linear_programming_with_cbc
steps: Formulate as MILP: minimize 50x + 100y subject to 50x + 100y <= 2000, x - 2y >= 500, x,y >= 0 integers
Use PuLP with CBC solver to find optimal integer solution
If infeasible, try alternative constraint interpretations
key_insight: Two-variable integer LP with budget and reach constraints. Y is more expensive ($100/unit) so we prefer X, but X must exceed twice Y by 500 points. This creates tension: to minimize cost we want small x,y but reach requires large x.
